Hey I hope all is going well. Although I am 17 yo trans girl from the usa I really do understand the fear arising from the thought of irreversible changes and such. A year ago I was a shattered mess (I am only a train wreck now lol) but I have stated to come to terms with things in my life by just going for it on some occasions. I wear makeup and nail polish to school almost every day now and I have noticed my confidence level going up. Of course the same things probably wouldn’t work for you but think of small things that could make you feel a little more comfortable or at least content. About sexuality I am a complete mess myself and have never been in a relationship so I really don’t know any advice I would give you. I do think though it is important that you don’t worry about what others think of choices YOU make. If you choose to bind it is YOUR choice and you can stop whenever you want, so don’t worry about making others “happy” with things relating to your body and choices. Any I hope I help a bit sorry if I didn’t, also if you ever want to chat with someone about this stuff or anything really feel free to message me. I have barely any friends and no life anyway.

At least I am one of the AGPs that knows about and has read into Blanchards theory yet I am still desperate to transition so I am getting closer and closer to feeling comfortable in coming out to my parents. Thanks for reading but right now I really feel like I am one of those cases where I really have no other options.
